description: This file is a Bash script used for managing firmware upgrades on specific hardware platforms. It contains functions for setting environment variables, checking image integrity, and performing upgrades based on the device model.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A simple function that always returns success, used to check the firmware image.

methods.name: yuncore_fap650_env_setup
methods.description: Sets up environment variables for the yuncore fap650 platform, including boot configuration and slot management scripts.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs platform-specific upgrade procedures based on the device model, invoking appropriate upgrade commands.
